overview_description.description: DAMAC Properties, a subsidiary of DAMAC Group, is a real estate developer specializing in residential, commercial, and leisure properties. The company has built a portfolio that includes skyscrapers, communities, and branded residences across various locations. Since its establishment, DAMAC has completed thousands of homes and continues to develop new projects. Its developments contribute to urban expansion and infrastructure growth in the regions where they are located.

about_short_description.short_description: DAMAC Properties develops residential, commercial, and leisure properties, creating skyscrapers, communities, and branded residences.

product.name: Residential Property Development
product.description: Development and sale of apartments, villas, townhouses, penthouses, serviced residences, and other residential units in master-planned communities and high-rise buildings.

product.name: Master-Planned Communities
product.description: Large-scale residential communities that combine housing with amenities such as golf facilities, water features, sports venues, retail, dining, and leisure services.

product.name: Branded Residences
product.description: Residential properties developed in collaboration with luxury fashion, hospitality, and design brands, combining branded interiors, amenities, and service standards.

product.name: Commercial and Mixed-Use Property Development
product.description: Development and sale or leasing of commercial and mixed-use real estate, including office, retail, hotel, residential, dining, and entertainment components.

product.name: Hotels, Resorts and Serviced Apartments
product.description: Development and operation of hotels, resorts, and serviced apartments with accommodation, food and beverage, wellness, fitness, pool, and guest services.

product.name: Retail and Shopping Destinations
product.description: Development of shopping and community retail destinations that include stores, supermarkets, dining venues, entertainment facilities, and other customer services.
